# lumos_knowledge_contexts (Data Source)

KnowledgeContexts DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_knowledge_contexts" "my_knowledgecontexts" {
  page_size  = 10
  page_token = "...my_page_token..."
  product_scopes = [
    "ALBUS_DEEP_RESEARCH"
  ]
  title_search = "...my_title_search..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 25 are clamped to 25 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `product_scopes` (List of String) Filter to entries tagged with any of these product scopes.
- `title_search` (String) Case-insensitive substring match against knowledge entry titles.

### Read-Only

- `knowledge_context` (Attributes List) Knowledge entries on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--knowledge_context))
- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

<a id="nestedatt--knowledge_context"></a>
### Nested Schema for `knowledge_context`

Read-Only:

- `application_tags` (Attributes List) Application tags attached to the entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--knowledge_context--application_tags))
- `content` (String) Body text of the knowledge entry (markdown supported).
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 creation timestamp.
- `file_url` (String) URL of the attached file, if any.
- `generic_tags` (List of String) Freeform tag strings attached to the entry.
- `id` (String) UUID of the knowledge entry.
- `product_scopes` (List of String) Products that can consume this knowledge entry.
- `title` (String) Title of the knowledge entry.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 last-updated timestamp.

<a id="nestedatt--knowledge_context--application_tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `knowledge_context.application_tags`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the application tag.
- `name` (String) Display name of the application tag.
